text:
Sophia Chen: Hey team — need to lock BlueQuartz customer story recording + quote approvals. Launch window: 2025-05-07 to align with benchmarking blog and webinar. Can we confirm recording slots + legal signoff timeline? cc @marketing @legal

Matt Rivera: Available windows: May 1-3 mornings PST or May 6 afternoon. I can book 60min slot, will capture product walkthrough + 10m quote soundbites. Here's calendar: https://cal.example/bluequartz

Olivia Park: BlueQuartz confirmed they prefer May 6 after 1pm PT. They want webinar tie-in. Will confirm speakers: CTO + Growth lead.

Laura Kim: Producer here — remote interview recommended. I'll prepare a runbook. Draft checklist:
```
- 30min pre-call tech check
- 45min interview (questions + demo)
- 10min soundbites
- Post-call: transcript + quote capture
```
Zoom link template: zoom.us/meet/bluequartz

Daniel Torres: Legal — we need the proposed quoted lines in writing and a signed release form before publishing. Target review time: 48 business hours after receipt. Also need permission for benchmark numbers if we're including them.

Sophia Chen: Got it. I'll ask BlueQuartz for quote drafts and a signed release. Who's owning the benchmark slide/metrics?

Olivia Park: I'll request the numbers from our analytics team after the interview. We should not call any CPU/latency figures out loud until legal clears customer-owned metrics.

Matt Rivera: Noted. I'll set the recording for 2025-05-06 13:30 PT and invite everyone. Recording duration 65min.

workflow-bot: Document uploaded: /legal/releases/bluequartz_release_draft_v1.docx

Daniel Torres: Received the draft. Please route edits in comments. If they add any new metric claims, flag me.

Sophia Chen: Assignments: Olivia — get quote drafts from customer by 2025-04-29. Laura — send runbook + tech check invite. Matt — calendar + recording. Daniel — legal review + release form. I'll coordinate webinar slot and promo timeline.

Matt Rivera: Quick Q: Do we want the case study published same week as webinar? Helps with inbound routing via the playbook.

Olivia Park: Yes, publish case study 2 days before webinar, embargo lift on webinar day. Need legal ok for embargo.

Daniel Torres: Fine with embargo flow. We'll aim to complete review by 2025-05-04 if drafts arrive by 04-29.

Sophia Chen: Perfect. Thanks all :rocket:

Laura Kim: I'll post post-production ETA after recording (likely 3 business days).

Olivia Park: I'll prepare inbound routing tags: lead_source=bluequartz_case, webinar=may7, benchmark=beta. Will share routing doc.

Sophia Chen: Awesome — closing loop here. If anyone runs into blockers ping me directly.
